name: comp-305

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the strip from message through Learn more to the close X with no cursor over it.
frames.render_note: The left edge is cropped, so the leading eclipse icon and the start of the message are cut off.

tagline: A dark strip announces a new feature and can be closed with an X.
summary: A full-width dark bar with a short update message, a Learn more link whose arrow nudges on hover, and a close button that removes the bar from the page.
appearance: A full-width dark strip sits across the top of the stage with a faint divider beneath it. Small light text runs in from the left; at the right sit a Learn more link with a small arrow and a faint X.
behaviour: Hovering Learn more slides its arrow a little and the X brightens. Pressing the X takes the whole banner away; otherwise nothing moves while it is open.
demo_content: We just added something awesome to make your experience even better.
search_phrases: bar with learn more and close
new feature banner you can hide
use_when: You want to announce a new feature in a skimmable strip that visitors can dismiss.
avoid_when: Dismissal lives in memory only, so the bar returns on reload; long copy crowds the single row.
customise: The message, link target and labels are written into the file; visibility is local state and no props tune it.
weight_why: One strip and a single state flag; nothing animates until hovered.

a11y.note: The close button is labelled and icons are hidden, but the link has no custom focus style and dismissal is not remembered.

issues: The clip crops the banner's left edge, cutting the leading eclipse icon and first words.
Dismissal is in-memory only, so the banner reappears on reload.
polish_why: Clean compact strip; the clipped icon and one fixed line of copy hold it back.
title: Dismissible Feature Banner
